name: Algebra
description: Linear and quadratic equations, polynomials, sequences, Surds, and inequalities.

name: Geometry
description: 2D and 3D shapes, angles, theorems, area, volume, and geometric constructions.

name: Trigonometry
description: Trigonometric ratios, identities, sine/cosine laws, and periodic functions.

name: Coordinate Geometry
description: Lines, distance formulas, slopes, circles, parabolas, and conic sections.

name: Calculus
description: Limits, derivatives, integrals, differential equations, and series.

name: Probability
description: Combinatorics, permutations, conditional probability, and random variables.

name: Statistics
description: Mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation, and normal distributions.

name: Matrices
description: Matrix operations, determinants, inverses, and systems of linear equations.

name: Vectors
description: Dot product, cross product, vector magnitude, projection, and 3D space.

name: Logarithms
description: Logarithmic identities, change of base, exponential growth, and decay.
